summary: Comprehensive testing of inGastro Cloud OS iteration 2 (Magazyn/BOM, Public Storefront + Stripe, Pyszne.pl integration). Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass covering settings/PayU validation, inventory CRUD + stock + movements + alerts, stock deduction (on_create -> deduct 250g & cancel_return, on_ready -> defer until ready), public store (no auth, no recipes), min_order/address validation, cash + online flows, pending_payment hidden from /orders?status=new, Stripe checkout session creation + idempotency, pyszne webhook auth (missing/wrong key -> 401, disabled -> 401), SKU + name mapping with variant 40cm & Rukola modifier, extras mapping, idempotency by order_id, unmapped item detection, test-order, menu-export, menu-push (simulated). Frontend: all sidebar entries (Magazyn BOM, Sklep online, Integracje) rendered, /inventory shows 15 ingredients with stock-qty/stock-row/add-delivery/add-ingredient and tabs; /store-settings has deduction & provider toggles (provider-payu without creds returned 400 as expected), open-store-link points to /s/pizzeria-savona; /integrations generates key, test-order appends row, menu-push shows 'Wypchnięto 11 produktów (simulated)' toast; public storefront at /s/pizzeria-savona works with store-name, category tabs, product-dialog with variants/modifiers/qty-plus, add-to-cart, cart-subtotal, go-checkout, checkout-form (name/phone/address), cash path navigates to /s/pizzeria-savona/order/{id} with order-tracking step-new active and order-total 73 zł (64 + 9 dostawa), online path redirects to checkout.stripe.com (confirmed URL). /s/unknown-slug shows store-error, /payment/cancel shows payment-cancelled. KDS shows PYSZNE.PL badges via kds-source-*, /orders shows order-source-* with 'Online'/'Pyszne.pl' and 'Oczekuje na płatność' status badge for pending_payment orders.

issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by a dev-only tracker wrapper inside <select><option>{l.name}</option></select> in CheckoutForm.jsx line ~55. Non-blocking but prints an error on every public order render.

action_items: (cosmetic) The <option> renders a <span> child in dev builds (visual editor instrumentation). Consider rendering {l.name} as a plain string or using a shadcn Select to avoid the React hydration warning.
No functional issues – PayU real-checkout path untested (no merchant creds); only validation/config paths exercised as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: extensions.py is ~950 lines – consider splitting into submodules (settings/, inventory/, store/, aggregators/) for maintainability.
payu_token in-process cache _payu_tokens: Dict[str, tuple] is not safe for multi-worker uvicorn deployments; move to Redis or DB if horizontally scaled.
map_pyszne_items iterates products in Python per item (O(N·M)); fine for demo but add an index on products.sku if catalogs grow.
public_create_order recomputes pricing from catalog (good – never trusts client); min_order check happens BEFORE adding delivery_fee – intentional per spec but documented inline would help.
Idempotency on pyszne webhook uses external_id + aggregator – good; but no replay protection within the same order_id window if payload mutates (not required by spec).
seed_data_creation: Tests created a few TEST_ ingredients (self-cleaned), stock-movements with note=TEST (harmless), and a handful of orders (TEST customer_name, TEST Online, TEST Klient) + Pyszne test orders. State restored at the end: stock_deduction_mode=on_create, payment_provider=stripe, payu cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_extensions.py (run with `pytest -n 0` to serialize – xdist parallel execution causes shared-state races on inventory/stock deduction tests). Iteration 1 covered auth/POS/KDS/orders basics (already green). Known cosmetic issue: CheckoutForm renders a dev-time instrumentation <span> inside <option> causing hydration warning. Everything else is clean.
